fact: ARCOP says the APPEL public procurement platform, in its pilot phase since 14 October 2025, includes an integrated AI-based assistant that guides users on regulatory and technical matters.

Polygon says Senegal's chatbot Anta, developed by Sénégal Numérique SA, uses AI intent detection and voice recognition to answer users and guide them through administrative procedures on the Service Public portal.
ARCOP's pilot completion report lists an AI assistant specialised in the public procurement code and a chatbot among the support provided to users of the APPEL platform.
